WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
bucket_shares AS (
  SELECT order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
),
kept_buckets AS (
  SELECT order_count, share
  FROM bucket_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM bucket_shares)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_count), 0) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM bucket_shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM kept_buckets;
